name: Tenant Inbox
office_task: Read the agency's shared inbox, file every tenant, landlord and tradie message against its tenancy, work order or creditor, and hand each tenant complaint whole to its property manager.
systems_of_record: the mail system that issues the message_id (the agency's shared Gmail or Outlook mailbox)
the property management system that issues the tenancy_id and holds the maintenance work orders and creditor records messages are filed against (PropertyMe, Console Cloud or similar)
the exception desk the agency runs, holding the queue table and its items

emits.write: the message filed against the tenancy, maintenance work order or creditor it belongs to, by that record's own id; for a tradie's invoice, each attachment filed as evidence on the creditor record with its hash and the message_id, where a bill check reads it next
emits.readback: reading the record back by message_id returns the filing with its record_ref (tenancy:<tenancy_id>, job:<work order id> or supplier:<creditor id>) and every evidence row with its hash; no record_ref back means nothing was filed and the message stays an open task for the other queue's owner

emits.write: an item on the exception desk naming the person who owns it, one per thread: a message waiting on its queue owner's reply, an unmatched message left as a task, a tenant complaint handed whole to its property manager with nothing sent to the tenant, or an item past its kind's clock handed to the owner's manager
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id (the item id), and reading the record back by message_id returns the item with its kind, record_ref, owner, due date and every outbound with who released it; no item back means nothing was raised and the message is escalated to the other queue's owner

port_of.original_name: Triage tenant complaints with GPT-4.1, Slack, email and Google Sheets
